name: Wyrd · Evidence Thread
description: Canonical token source for Wyrd's Evidence Thread design system, shared by the documentation site and the workbench. Edit here, then run `node brand/gen-theme.mjs` to regenerate every projection (workbench theme.css, docs wyrd-tokens.css, the wyrd-ui skill theme, and the Wyrd mark renderings). Consumers never restate a value from this file. The human reference is DESIGN.md + ./renders/styleguide.html.

--bg.role: Canvas — the page field. Light is Bohmian cool paper; dark is the blue-black canvas, always darker than its panels.

--surface.role: Surface — primary panel and chrome, lifted above the canvas in both modes.

--surface-2.role: Surface secondary — subordinate regions, panel headers, and neutral controls.

--text.role: Ink — primary text and the strongest rule.

--muted.role: Muted ink — supporting text and metadata.

--border.role: Rule — one-pixel structural dividers and control borders. Separation only; never the sole identifier of a control.

--border-soft.role: Rule soft — row and subordinate dividers.

--declare.role: Declare / primary — cobalt in light, periwinkle in dark: the one hue that shifts per mode. Declaration identity, links, selection, focus, and the primary action.

--declare-soft.role: Declare soft — selected or contextual declaration field.

--declare-ink.role: Label on a --declare fill (the primary action).

--observe.role: Observe — observed facts and Observation identity. The same lime in both modes; a fill, line, or underline, never text on a light field.

--observe-soft.role: Observe soft — lime wash for a selected or contextual observation field; ordinary ink on top.

--evidence.role: Retained Evidence — the retained-evidence signal, the Wyrd mark's center spine, and evidence-capture feedback only. Never a general accent, hover, or wash.

--evidence-ink.role: Label and outline on a --evidence fill. A dark ink in both modes; --evidence stays a light fill.

--ok.role: Success — the same green in both modes; always paired with a glyph or word.

--warn.role: Warning — the same amber in both modes; always paired with a glyph or word.

--danger.role: Failure — the same red in both modes; always paired with a glyph or word.

--danger-soft.role: Failure soft — red wash for a failure context field; ordinary ink on top.

--code-bg.role: Code surface — code and terminal blocks: the dark panel field in both modes, lifted above the dark canvas.

--code-muted.role: Code comment and punctuation ink. The code field is dark in both modes.

--code-keyword.role: Code keyword and storage ink (declaration syntax).

--code-string.role: Code string and literal-value ink (lime, the evidence hue).

--code-number.role: Code number, constant, function-name, and control-keyword ink (amber).

--weight-strong.role: Strong weight — headings, labels, and emphasis. Capped at 600 in dark mode, where light-on-dark text renders heavier.

--r.role: Radius — restrained two-pixel corners (true circles only for dots/avatars).

$pairs: Contrast contract, asserted by gen-theme.mjs in BOTH modes. Every foreground/background pairing the applications render as text is declared here so a palette edit that breaks one fails the token gate instead of shipping. `min` is the floor for the role: 7.0 for body ink, 4.5 for secondary and link ink, 4.0 for declare ink on its own wash, 1.2 for structural rules (separation only). The lime, green, amber, and red hues are deliberately identical in both modes (approved 2026-09-26) and are not text-contrast contracts on light fields: lime renders only as a fill, line, or underline with --evidence-ink on top; status hues render as labels that always carry a glyph or word and a two-pixel colored border. Rule pairs are structural separation and never the sole identifier of a control; see DESIGN.md 'Rules are structure'.
